description: Report format for compiler optimization analysis of /app/target.c

divide_by_7.has_div_instruction: boolean: at -O2, does divide_by_7's assembly contain a div or idiv instruction?
divide_by_7.has_mul_instruction: boolean: at -O2, does divide_by_7's assembly contain a mul or imul instruction?

modulo_13.has_div_instruction: boolean: at -O2, does modulo_13's assembly contain a div or idiv instruction?
modulo_13.has_mul_instruction: boolean: at -O2, does modulo_13's assembly contain a mul or imul instruction?

accumulate.has_memory_write_in_loop_body: boolean: at -O2, does the inner loop body of accumulate contain a memory store instruction?
accumulate.optimization_blocker: string: explain the language-level constraint that causes the compiler to emit the observed inefficient code pattern

fill_multiples.has_imul_in_loop_body: boolean: at -O2, does the inner loop body of fill_multiples contain an imul instruction?
fill_multiples.has_compiler_introduced_add: boolean: at -O2, does the loop body contain an add instruction that replaces source-level arithmetic?

sum_floats.vectorized_at_O3_avx2: boolean: at -O3 -mavx2, does sum_floats use packed float SIMD additions (vaddps or addps)?
sum_floats.vectorized_at_O3_avx2_ffast_math: boolean: at -O3 -mavx2 -ffast-math, does sum_floats use packed float SIMD additions?
sum_floats.vectorization_blocker: string: explain why -O3 -mavx2 alone is insufficient to auto-vectorize this loop

categorize.uses_jump_table: boolean: does the switch use an indirect jump through a table of code addresses?
categorize.uses_data_lookup_table: boolean: does GCC emit a separate data table to look up return values?
